admission.justification: Future changes to task-page reads, conditional transport, native generation capture or retained-content ownership must prevent stale or unbounded cache reuse and a counter failure blocking the document. Named current source assertions guard the specified facets; historical timing/count samples remain task-local, not enduring obligations or fresh Curator grades.

applicability: Change-set results served through the app-owned native read context.
conditions: A landed id-keyed hit returns the same list, file and counter bytes as the native read for those ids.
A working change-set view is not cached and is computed natively on every read.
A failed or unreadable native read is not retained; a refusal may settle only on the named unknown-status proof.
For change-set results the working view is always native; the generic summary cache may retain a working-observed summary, which is not a change-set result.
exclusions: No byte-equality claim for a changed or mutated read; no cache for a working change-set view.
statement: An id-keyed cached change set is byte-identical to the native read, a working view is always native, and unreadable native inputs are computed without retention.
